steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and formal project management education—no work experience necessary. If you hold a high school diploma or equivalent and can complete the required contact hours, you're ready to begin. This removes barriers for Melbourne professionals entering the field.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format condenses the required contact hours into a focused program, allowing you to learn project management fundamentals, terminology, and processes directly from certified instructors without lengthy classroom schedules.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the online application process, ensuring your eligibility documentation is complete and your registration moves forward without delay.

steps_items.text: After earning CAPM, commit to a three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning opportunities to help you meet renewal requirements and stay current in project management practices.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
